title: Okay, third time’s a charm. I’ve made comments, but this is my first post. Uncomfortably close AI version of my Mall World mall. Anyone been here before?
content: I’ve tried posting this two times before and I screwed it up, so here I go again. I’ve been going to Mall World for at least 30 years, but it’s picked up in the last 10 years and I go every night. Ad with others I have… the Mall Proper, a weird airport, a casino/arcade, a discount store, a slum city, a ship, amusement park with roller coasters, cemeteries, high end housing development, steep roads, lots of big trees, an antebellum mansion that is dilapidated, and it’s always evening to late night. Have any of you been there? (btw, the casino/arcade is up the escalator to the right! lol)
